[size=6][b]NPC Helper (v1.0.2)[/b][/size]

[color=orange]Status: Abandoned / Early Prototype[/color]

NPC Helper is an experimental framework that explored an alternative approach to creating custom NPCs for Stardew Valley. Using TOML configuration files, it provided a structured way to define characters, dialogue, schedules, and assets without requiring extensive knowledge of the game's internal systems.

This was a learning project and personal exploration of Stardew Valley modding systems. It was never intended to replace or compete with established tools, but simply to exist as another option in the modding ecosystem.

[list]
[*][url=https://tamkungz.github.io/documentation/npc-helper/]Documentation[/url][/*]
[/list]
[u]What This Is[/u]
[list]
[*]An experimental approach to NPC creation using TOML files[/*]
[*]A personal project for learning Stardew Valley modding systems[/*]
[*]Kept online for reference and for existing users only[/*]
[*]Replaced by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54754]NPC Helper 2[/url][/*]
[/list]
[u]What This Is NOT[/u]
[list]
[*]Maintained or supported[/*]
[*]A replacement for Content Patcher or other established tools[/*]
[*]A production-ready framework for commercial projects[/*]
[*]A complete solution for all NPC-related needs[/*]
[/list]
[u]Core Concepts[/u]
[list]
[*]Define NPCs using TOML configuration files[/*]
[*]Dialogue follows Stardew Valley's standard key format[/*]
[*]Dynamic sprite/portrait variants based on location/season[/*]
[*]Separate files for dialogue, schedules, and localization[/*]
[*]Runtime registration without file patching[/*]
[/list]
[u]Installation[/u]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI[/*]
[*]Place in Mods folder[/*]
[*]Create TOML files for your NPCs[/*]
[*]Launch game - NPCs register automatically[/*]
[/list]
[u]Basic Structure[/u]
[code]
YourNPC.toml # Main definition
Dialogue.toml # Dialogue lines
Schedule.toml # Daily schedule
sprite.png # Character sprite
portrait.png # Dialogue portrait[/code]
[u]Version 1.0.2 Changes[/u]

[*]Dialogue system now uses Stardew Valley's native format[/*]

[/list]

This version is no longer supported. If you have problems, please move to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54754]NPC Helper 2[/url] and check its page.
